contributions.detail: This is the CYCLE-FINAL report and its Form A (p4) restates the whole cycle: the same 8 rows as the 2018-10-29 filing (key 872220ae), summing to exactly 1375.00 = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE. The THIS REPORT cell is a slashed-zero glyph, which per the repo zero-glyph ruling IS 0 (recorded '0', glyph noted) -- no new contributions in the period -- so the rows are unambiguously on the CUMULATIVE scope, not the period scope. The Carr form prints no schedule total; the filer's own hand-written totals on the sheet (Total cash 1125.00 / Total in kind 400.00 / GRAND TOTAL 1525.00) are unchanged from the earlier filing and cross-check the same way (1375 itemized + 150 sub-$50 aggregate = 1525). The ledger's 'aggregate donations less than $50' line is again NOT emitted as a row (it is cover line 2).

expenditures.basis: cover-line3-cumulative (and the filer's own hand-written 'Total spent 1,322.80' on Form B)
expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) is the SAME PHYSICAL SHEET as the earlier filing's Form B, photocopied again after the filer added two new rows in blue ballpoint (10/25/18 Facebook Ads 230.00 and 10/31/18 Facebook Ad 50.00) and a new blue 'Total spent 1,322.80'. All 15 rows are therefore on the page and they sum to 1323.40 against the printed 1,322.80 -- delta 0.60, EXACTLY the delta the earlier filing already carried (1043.40 vs 1,042.80). The 0.60 is inherited filer arithmetic and is not attributable to any cell: every amount was re-read at 600-900 dpi on this cleaner colour scan and all thirteen carried-over values read identically to the earlier scan. TWO INDEPENDENT CORROBORATIONS that the ROWS are right and the filer's total is 0.60 short: (1) the cover's THIS REPORT cell reads 280.00, which is EXACTLY the two new blue rows 230.00 + 50.00 -- the period increment gates perfectly; (2) the cover's CUMULATIVE 1322.80 = 1042.80 + 280.00, i.e. the filer carried forward his own earlier Form B total (1042.80), not the rounded 1,042 he wrote in his own LAST REPORT cell. Both figures retained verbatim, no row adjusted, needs_review=1 on every row of the side. Scope is CUMULATIVE because the emitted row set is the whole cycle; a consumer wanting the period-only figure has it in the 280.00 anchor and in rows 14-15.

gates.page_subtotal: The Carr 5-5-PG form prints no schedule total and no page subtotal on either schedule; the cover block is the only printed anchor (the 'Total spent' figure on Form B is the filer's own hand-written line, not a printed field, and is recorded as filer_written_total_spent). Form A gate: p4 rows 1375.00 = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE 1375.00, EXACT. Form B gate: p3 rows 1323.40 vs cover line 3 CUMULATIVE 1322.80 -- WOULD NOT GATE, delta 0.60. Sub-gate that DID fire: rows 14+15 = 280.00 = cover line 3 THIS REPORT 280.00, exact.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py is unusable on both money pages of this filing for the same reason as the sibling: the printed rules are lost under the filer's ink across the whole inked region and the tool returns rules only from the empty lower half. Counted by ink instead, and cross-checked against the earlier filing of the same sheets: p4 (Form A) carries the identical 8 itemized rows + 1 sub-$50 aggregate line + 3 filer total lines + 1 legend line -> 8 rows emitted, same count as key 872220ae, no row gained or lost. p3 (Form B) carries 13 black rows + 2 NEW blue rows + 1 blue 'Total spent' line -> 15 rows emitted, i.e. exactly 2 more than the 13 of key 872220ae, which is what the cover's 280.00 period figure predicts. The two counts corroborating each other across two independent scans is the strongest row-count evidence available here.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 (Form B): first-row crop pct:81.50,13.60,14.00,2.10 renders '11.72'; last-row crop pct:81.50,45.24,14.00,2.10 renders '50.00' (the final blue row); control one pitch past it (47.50) renders the filer's blue '1,322.80' Total-spent line -- a total line, not a transaction, which is exactly what should sit there and proves the row index is not shifted; a second control a further pitch down (49.76) renders EMPTY. p4 (Form A): first-row crop pct:81.50,13.70,14.00,2.10 renders '$500.00'; last-row crop pct:81.50,29.45,14.00,2.10 renders '$200 -> in kind'; control one pitch past the sub-$50 aggregate line (33.95) renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: CROSS-FILING CHAIN (the check the core brief asks for when one chunk holds two filings by one filer in one cycle) -- RUN, AND IT CLOSES ON ALL THREE LINES. The earlier filing (key 872220ae, 2018-10-29) prints CUMULATIVE 1375.00 / 150.00 / 1,042; this filing prints TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT 1375.00 / 150.00 / 1,042. Identical, line for line, so the two covers are correctly paired and neither is a swapped or mis-sequenced cover. WITHIN this filing, line 3 also closes as printed: 1,042 LAST + 280.00 THIS is 1322.00, but the CUMULATIVE cell reads 1322.80 -- the 0.80 gap is the filer carrying forward his true 1042.80 rather than the rounded 1,042 he wrote in his own LAST cell, which is a consistent (if untidy) filer practice rather than an error. THE BALANCE LINE DOES NOT CLOSE on any single consistent basis: cover line 4 prints -47 in the CUMULATIVE column only (LAST and THIS blank, no cents). The nearest basis is 1275 - 1322.80 = -47.80, where 1275 = the 1125 'cash' the filer annotates against line 1 PLUS the 150 sub-$50 aggregate again; but that double-counts the aggregate, because in the earlier filing his +83 balance came from 1125 - 1042 with the 150 already inside the 1125. So the filer switched his own balance basis between the two reports. Reported, not repaired.

PRIVACY: cover prints the candidate's home street address and two phone numbers, p2 prints her home address again, and Form A prints donor streets and ZIPs -- all discarded at read time; only donor_city/donor_state are emitted.
